name: Create Circuit Diagram Lesson
description:
Create a 3-page interactive science lesson on electrical circuits.

Your task:
1. Create a new flipchart in ActivInspire.
2. Page 1 (Introduction): Add the title 'Electrical Circuits', text mentioning both 'series' and 'parallel', and an 'Essential Question'.
3. Page 2 (Series Circuit): Title 'Series Circuit'. Draw a diagram using shapes (lines, rectangles, etc.) representing a loop with a Battery, a Bulb (or Resistor), and a Switch. Label these 3 components with text.
4. Page 3 (Parallel Circuit): Title 'Parallel Circuit'. Draw a diagram with at least two branches containing a Battery, Bulb/Resistor, and Switch. Label the components. Add a text note about 'branches' or 'paths'.
5. Save the flipchart as '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/circuit_diagram_lesson.flipchart'.

Use the Shape tool for diagrams and Text tool for labels.
